pages.title: Stripe | Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue
pages.description: Stripe is a financial services platform that helps all types of businesses accept payments, build flexible billing models, and manage money movement.
headings: Flexible solutions for every business model.
Accept and optimize payments globally—online and in person
Access borderless money movement with stablecoins and crypto
Transform your enterprise with agile financial infrastructure
URBN consolidates $5 billion in online and in-store revenue onto Stripe.
Instacart powers online grocery delivery with Stripe.
Le Monde improves local and international payments with Stripe.
Build a foundation for your startup that enables faster growth
Make your SaaS platform a complete financial operating system
Reliable, extensible infrastructure for every stack.

pages.description: Create an event destination to receive events at an HTTPS webhook endpoint. Receiving webhook events allows you to listen to asynchronous events, such as when a customer's bank confirms a payment, a customer disputes a charge, a recurring payment succeeds, or you collect a subscription payment.
headings: Receive Stripe events in your webhook endpoint

pages.title: Build a Stripe-hosted checkout page | Stripe Documentation
pages.description: Learn how to integrate Stripe Checkout with a full, working code sample that lets your customers pay by clicking a button on your website that redirects to a Stripe-hosted payment page. The example includes client and server-side code, and a prebuilt payment page.

pages.title: Security at Stripe | Stripe Documentation
